name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cues: Lie on the floor with knees bent and feet flat
Start with the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing your feet
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees
Pause lightly on the floor, then press straight up
